hints: Think about what value makes a product zero.

questions.prompt: When a factor $(x - k)$ appears an even number of times, the graph of the polynomial ___ the $x$-axis at $x = k$.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: For even multiplicity, the graph touches (or bounces) but does not cross.
